front.label: Front
front.desc: A bearer instrument. One of twenty five, issued against HYPE genesis, payable to a name.

front.label: Serial
front.desc: Shown twice, as on a note: small at the top, large at the foot. Set when your card is confirmed.

front.label: Contactless
front.desc: Tap a phone to the card to read it. It needs no battery.

front.label: Bearer
front.desc: Your name, the only mark on the face that is not the issuer's. The ending is filled in mint.

front.label: Guilloche
front.desc: Banknote lace grown from your namehash and cut to the Hyperliquid mark. No two cards share the pattern, and no hand can redraw it.

front.label: Latent image
front.desc: Inside the lace the word HYPE is cut deeper. It shows only when light catches the metal at an angle.

front.label: Microtext clause
front.desc: The signed message and the bearer clause run round the border in type too small to print.

front.label: Issuer
front.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the two parties behind the card.

back.label: Back
back.desc: What a note keeps on its back: who it belongs to, the issue record, and a way to verify it.

back.label: Bearer block
back.desc: Your name in full. Your wallet and namehash are shown with only their ends, the rest redacted into the metal. Full values resolve onchain.

back.label: Security thread
back.desc: A strip down the card carrying your namehash in microtext. It surfaces through nine mint windows, like a thread in a note.

back.label: Issue record
back.desc: HYPE genesis: date, unix time, token id, supply, the distribution to 94,023 wallets, and the assistance fund.

back.label: Register
back.desc: Scan to open this name's record in the ENS or Hyperliquid Names app, or tap the card.

back.label: Timeline
back.desc: Twenty four ticks from genesis to House of HYPE in Mumbai, one a month.

back.label: Denomination
back.desc: Twenty five pieces, written in words the way a note spells out its value.

back.label: Serial
back.desc: Your number out of 25, large, at the foot.
